summary: Initial three-host review has not confirmed unauthorized access. Public Grafana probes were rejected; recurring short deploy password sessions look consistent with legacy automation and are being correlated. Found exposed services and excessive deploy privileges; investigating and hardening while preserving staff access and the release, database, backup and payout jobs.

No unauthorized access confirmed in the restored logs or current sessions. Repeated deploy password connections match the older monitor’s automation pattern; current named staff and CI/backup sign-ins match historical sources and fingerprints. Removed dangerous deploy sudo permissions and CI agent/pivot paths, made CI root maintenance local and separated from repository-controlled execution, hardened WordPress uploads/support helpers, mediated Grafana with a normalizing proxy, and limited metrics and SQL exposure. Locked the unlisted legacy contractor account. Website, ride form, crawler sitemap, CI release, database jobs and payout checks have passed so far; monitoring continues.
